description: This file defines the AOW_Condition class, which is part of the AOW_Conditions module in SuiteCRM, an extension of SugarCRM. It manages conditions related to workflows, including properties for database schema, constructor, and methods for saving condition lines. The class interacts with other modules such as AOW_WorkFlow and utilizes external functions and classes like BeanFactory and LoggerManager.

classes.name: AOW_Condition
classes.description: Represents a workflow condition entity in SuiteCRM, extending Basic, with properties for database schema, constructor, and methods for saving condition lines.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of AOW_Condition, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates whether the bean implements a certain interface. Always returns false in this class.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Saves multiple condition lines based on POST data, handling serialization, encoding, and deletion flags, associated with a parent workflow object.
